title: Havalaea Native Fauna & Time-of-Troubles Lineage Source Evidence
authority_layers: owner-approved CEW Havalaea invariant for Time-of-Troubles native lineage versus later imported animals
Player Creatures.PDF Havalaean sapient-animal conversion source

source_documents.scope: world origin, convergence-ark ecology, Warden terraforming, relocation/reintroduction, Warden-bred and feral examples, Riftfall non-native/displaced ecology
46 setting-associated source creature profiles; source collection is not automatic lineage or canonical stable-ID authority
Havalaean Sapient Animal Template and cultural/character nativeness semantics

evidence_records.claim: Havalaea was created as a controlled convergence world and biodiverse ark where species and ecosystems from across realities could be studied and harmonized.
non_inference: Long residence in the ark does not by itself establish Time-of-Troubles native lineage.

evidence_records.claim: The Green Wardens terraformed Havalaea to balance thousands of species across the zones, while Goblin Imperial Engineering seeded zones with structured potential.
non_inference: Warden management, engineering or seeding is not automatically Time-of-Troubles native descent.

evidence_records.claim: After the Goblin Empire returned, many low-CR creatures were relocated to safer worlds.
non_inference: Relocation history does not establish whether a lineage was Time-of-Troubles native before relocation.

evidence_records.claim: The Nursery includes reintroduced species and a hook in which a relocated species has wandered back.
non_inference: Return or reintroduction does not automatically reclassify a lineage as native.

evidence_records.claim: Chirrals are described as lizard-bird hybrids once bred by the Green Wardens and now reproducing wild.
non_inference: Warden breeding and wild reproduction do not prove Time-of-Troubles native lineage.
No canonical stable-ID binding is created.

evidence_records.claim: Dustroot Hounds are described as once-domesticated hunting beasts gone feral.
non_inference: Feral status is not native-lineage proof.
Domestication history remains independent of Time-of-Troubles ancestry.

evidence_records.claim: Riftfall Verge creatures are often not native, but displaced, hybridized, or partially conceptual.
non_inference: Riftfall occurrence does not widen canonical distribution outside explicit source scope.

evidence_records.claim: The retained Havalaea creature source contains 46 stat-profile starts across its setting-associated corpus.
non_inference: Collection membership is not automatic canonical identity, current presence, or Time-of-Troubles native lineage.

evidence_records.claim: The template converts a normal animal species into a fully sentient, speaking and culturally aware native of Havalaea.
non_inference: The template's native-of-Havalaea wording is conversion/cultural authority and does not independently prove Time-of-Troubles ecological lineage.
Sapience does not erase animal ecological identity.

evidence_records.claim: Native-born Havalaean fauna descended from Time-of-Troubles lineages must remain distinguishable from later imported animals; human-level native animals preserve animal ecological identity and may project through the NPC system.
non_inference: The invariant defines the class but does not identify individual stable IDs without separate authority.
NPC projection does not create humanoid identity, ownership, tamability or loss of autonomy.

canonical_havalaea_presence_carryforward.reason: CEW-05 explicitly records Havalaea presence but leaves native status unknown; CEW-01/07 prohibit name-only PDF binding.

boundaries: Source and owner evidence define lineage categories without silently binding current canonical stable IDs.

Time-of-Troubles lineage is not inferred from namespace, display name, source collection, habitat fit, current presence, wildness, ferality, Warden engineering, return, reintroduction or cultural nativeness.
Sapient/person-level animal handling consumes CEW-09 consent and identity rules.
Mount, pet/companion and familiar pathway assignment remains CEW-11-owned.
No application runtime, schema, UI, migration, canonical Creature Definition population or live relationship-state mutation is authorized.
